products.title: Aurelian Orbis Subwoofer
products.body_html:
Combining thunderous low-frequency extension with refined precision, PB-5000 R|Evolution sets a new standard for ported subwoofers in its class. Reaching down to a staggering 13Hz, it energizes rooms with cinematic slam and musical detail in perfect harmony.

A reimagined 15-inch high-excursion driver with dual voice coils, driven by a 2,000-watt Continuous, 5,000+ Peak, Dual Monoblock amplifier, delivers effortless, controlled power. The 295 MHz DSP ensures flawless tuning, while the SVS Subwoofer Control app gives you total command of performance and personalization.

products.title: Everdon Vista Subwoofer
products.body_html:
Seismic output below 17Hz with pinpoint accuracy and musical precision. Born from flagship SVS technology, the sealed cabinet SB-5000 R|Evolution subwoofer delivers breathtaking dynamics and effortless control to thrill audiophiles and home theater fans alike.

A reimagined 15-inch high-excursion driver with dual voice coils, driven by a 2,000-watt Continuous, 5,000+ Peak, Dual Monoblock amplifier, delivers effortless, controlled power. The 295 MHz DSP ensures flawless tuning, while the SVS Subwoofer Control app gives you total command of performance and personalization.
